headword: {交換留学|こうかんりゅうがく}

definitions.gloss: exchange program; student exchange; study abroad exchange
definitions.explanation: An educational program where students from one institution study at a partner institution abroad, typically with reciprocal arrangements between the two schools.

examples.japanese: {交換留学|こうかんりゅうがく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦アメリカ→アメリカ：01769_amerika⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to America on an exchange program.

examples.japanese: {交換留学|こうかんりゅうがく}{生|せい}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧1⟦{年間|ねんかん}→年間：00974_nenkan⟧ドイツ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{学|まな}んだ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: I studied in Germany for one year as an exchange student.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{交換留学|こうかんりゅうがく}⟦{協定|きょうてい}→協定：05320_kyoutei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{結|むす}んでいる→結ぶ：02308_musubu⟧。
examples.english: This university has student exchange agreements with universities around the world.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧ (exchange) and ⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧ (studying abroad). {交換留学|こうかんりゅうがく}{生|せい} refers to an exchange student. Distinguished from general ⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧ by the reciprocal nature of the arrangement between institutions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {交換留学|こうかんりゅうがく}{生|せい} (exchange student)
- {交換留学|こうかんりゅうがく}⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧ (exchange program system)
- {交換留学|こうかんりゅうがく}⟦{協定|きょうてい}→協定：05320_kyoutei⟧ (exchange agreement)
- {交換留学|こうかんりゅうがく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応募|おうぼ}→応募：03014_oubo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to apply for an exchange program)
